title: 3.6.7 Chart the Code: Reassignment vs. Mutation Trace
description: Trace a function that mutates an array and then reassigns it, and chart which write the caller can see.

aiGrader.rubricTitle: Reassign vs mutate chart: structure check
aiGrader.prompt: This chart is scored entirely by rules from its shapes and arrows. No model reads it.

rubric.title: The call is one function-call shape
rubric.description: Scored by the editor (shape kind): a double-rail function-call shape on the path.

steps.fail: A call to a function has its own shape, the double-rail rectangle from the shape palette.
steps.pass: A function-call shape is on the path.

rubric.title: Call, two decisions, then one print
rubric.description: Scored by the editor (arrow order): the call, then a decision, then another decision, then the print, on every route.

steps.fail: The order matters: the call comes first, then the question after the mutation, then the question after the reassignment, then the print once.
steps.pass: Call, two questions and the print are in order.

rubric.title: Each question splits into two different results
rubric.description: Scored by the editor: a decision whose yes and no arrows lead to two different shapes, and a print.

steps.fail: Each diamond must have a yes and a no arrow that lead to two different places.
steps.pass: The decision has two different exits.

steps.fail: The two paths rejoin before one print. Draw an input/output step for the print.

gate.fail: None of your shapes say what this program does. Label each shape in your own words.
